reader.title: The Brakes Need a Test
reader.overview: Ezra Klein asks former OpenAI safety-report writer David Robinson why he left and whether the industry's safety process can keep up with faster model and agent work. The automatic video text presents an uncertain but serious risk case, not a prediction that catastrophe is certain.
reader.whyItMatters: Watch selected exchanges if you need to decide what evidence a frontier lab should show before its safety claim earns trust. Skip the full 74:55 if you need measured incident rates or a completed independent audit; the interview does not supply either.
reader.ghostMeshTakeaway: The useful test is whether a warning reaches a named threshold, an accountable pause-or-proceed decision, and a scoped outside retest. Real pauses and a real intrusion both belong in the record; neither alone settles whether revised controls work.
reader.verdictScope: Selective watch, approximately 21 minutes; source starts are machine-text-derived and must be checked in the original video. No exact quote or visually observed demonstration is asserted.
